anchor.statement: Lemma 7.7. For every α ∈ R and nonzero integer m, let t m ∈ W α satisfy n Φ · t m = 0. Assume it is supported in the prescribed slow and transverse supports and compactly inside the pulse interval, with smooth zero extension across all these boundaries. The construction (7.38) gives C m ∈ W α +1/2 and r m ∈ W α +1/2− κs . The velocity (t m + r m )e ikm Φ = curl ∗ A m is exactly divergence-free for the normalized operators and after evaluation at the phase map. Potential and velocity have smooth zero extensions across their support boundaries. For the full amplitude a m = t m + r m , the scalar product with the phase normal satisfies ikm n Φ · a m = − (︁ (D r + R −1 )(a m ) r + D z (a m ) z )︁ , n Φ · a m ∈ W α +1/2− κs . (7.39) Physical potentials and pressures are obtained from chart ones by multiplication by Q 1/2−A and Q −2A , respectively.

correspondence.note: curl∗ A_m = (t_m + r_m)e^{ikmΦ}, exact divergence-freeness, r_m ∈ W_{α+1/2−κ}, and n_Φ · a_m ∈ W_{α+1/2−κ} via (7.39) are stated. Not stated: C_m ∈ W_{α+1/2}, and smooth zero extension of potential and velocity (only support inclusions are given).
